senses.definition: n.m. 2 S 7:17 vision (on format. cf. LgBN 200)—abs. ח׳ 2 S 7:17 Is 22:1, 5; cstr. חֶזְיוֹן Jb 20:8; 33:15; sf. חֶזְיֹנוֹ Zc 13:4; pl. abs. חֶזְיֹנוֹת Jb 7:14 Jo 3:1, cstr. id. Jb 4:13;—
vision, in the ecstatic state ראה ח׳ Jo 3:1; גּי(א) ח׳ valley of vision Is 22:1, 5.
vision, in the night חֶזְיוֹנ(וֹת) לַיְלָה Jb 4:13; 20:8; 33:15; ‖ חֲלֹמוֹת Jb 7:14.

divine communication in a vision, oracle, prophecy: ‖ דברים 2 S 7:17 (= חזון 1 Ch 17:15); יֵבשׁוּ אִישׁ מֵחֶזְיֹנוֹ בְּהִנָּֽכְאֹתוֹ Zc 13:4 they will be ashamed, every one of his vision when he prophesieth.
